Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a paradigm that enhances large language models (LLMs) by combining their generative capabilities with access to external knowledge, allowing them to retrieve relevant passages from an external database during inference to ground responses in factual context. The RAG framework typically consists of two core components: a retriever that selects relevant documents from a large corpus and a generator that synthesizes information from these documents to produce coherent responses.
